source_summary: Ink-and-wash Chinese landscape with layered mountains, misty water bands, riverside hamlets, pine-covered slopes, leafless foreground trees, rocks, and a small pavilion; inscriptions, red seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motif extraction.

motifs.name: central_layered_mountain
motifs.description: Isolate the dominant central mountain mass with stacked rounded ridges, craggy summit, shaded gullies, and scattered dark pine clusters; mask out any overlying red seal marks and avoid neighboring right waterfall cliffs.
must_preserve: soft grey ink washes defining rounded terraces
dry-brush rock texture and diagonal contour strokes
dark vertical pine-needle clusters on ledges
pale mist gaps between slopes
irregular crag line at the high summit

motifs.name: right_cliff_waterfall
motifs.description: Isolate the right-side cliff group with tall upright rock faces, narrow cascading waterfall, mist at the base, and adjacent small dark pavilion-like roof form on the ridge; exclude distant hills and red seals at the far right.
must_preserve: vertical rock outlines and layered wash on cliff faces
thin white waterfall channel with darker flanking strokes
soft misty wash where water meets valley
small angular roof strokes near the ridge
dark pine accents at the lower cliff edge

motifs.name: left_distant_river_hills
motifs.description: Isolate the low distant landscape at left: rolling hills, horizontal river or lake bands, faint shorelines, and small receding slopes beneath the inscription area; do not include calligraphy or seals.
must_preserve: pale graded wash on distant hills
thin horizontal waterline strokes
soft atmospheric fading at hill edges
small darker ridge accents
low shoreline contours

motifs.name: mid_left_riverside_hamlet_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the mid-left riverside hamlet with low thatched buildings, bare trees, and narrow bank lines along the water below the distant hills.
must_preserve: simple rectangular house walls and slanted roof geometry
fine bare tree trunks and twig marks
horizontal bank and water strokes
light wash around the settlement
small dark dots and reeds along the shore

motifs.name: mid_right_pine_slope
motifs.description: Isolate the mid-right sloping hillside covered with clustered conifers and darker pine marks emerging from mist, between the waterfall cliffs and foreground trees; exclude the red seal column at the far right.
must_preserve: stacked conifer silhouettes with dark ink tops
misty blank spaces separating tree groups
slanted hillside contour strokes
small clustered needle marks
soft grey wash receding into the valley

motifs.name: foreground_left_rocky_bank_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the left foreground rocky bank with rounded boulders, low scrub, bare saplings, and dark texture strokes; exclude nearby red seals along the left margin.
must_preserve: rounded boulder outlines with layered wash
dry-brush stipples and short dark texture dashes
thin bare tree trunks and forked branches
low shrub marks along the bank
curving ground contours leading toward the center

motifs.name: lower_center_village_roofs
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-center village cluster of several long low buildings partly screened by trees, including visible walls, tiled roofs, and surrounding ground lines.
must_preserve: parallel roof ridges and eave lines
rectangular wall outlines in pale ink
overlapping roof geometry showing depth
nearby tree trunks crossing in front
light ground wash and small dark footing marks

motifs.name: right_foreground_tree_mound_pavilion
motifs.description: Isolate the right foreground mound with large bare trees, root-like trunks, textured rocks, and the small pavilion at lower right; keep the tree-and-pavilion group separate from far-right seals and border.
must_preserve: thick dark tree trunks with forked branching structure
fine twig tips and leafless branch rhythm
rounded mound and rock wash texture
small pavilion roof with simple posts and eaves
dark base dots and brush accents around roots

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
